links.outcome: Failure rate of LLMs generating differential diagnoses versus final diagnoses on clinical vignettes
links.effect: Failure rates exceeded 0.80 (range, 0.90-1.00) for differential diagnosis in all models; below 0.40 (range, 0.09-0.39) for final diagnosis.
links.quote: Failure rates exceeded 0.80 (range, 0.90-1.00) for differential diagnosis in all models but were less than 0.40 (range, 0.09-0.39) for final diagnosis.

links.outcome: Whether multidimensional clinical reasoning benchmark reveals gaps hidden by traditional benchmarks/raw accuracy
links.effect: PrIME-LLM provided greater separation than raw accuracy, revealing reasoning gaps obscured by traditional benchmarks; scores ranged 0.64 to 0.78 across 21 LLMs.
links.quote: The PrIME-LLM framework provided greater separation than raw accuracy, revealing critical reasoning gaps obscured by traditional benchmarks.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking of 21 off-the-shelf LLMs across clinical vignettes evaluated by medical student scorers to assess longitudinal clinical reasoning across clinical workflow stages.
